page: OVHcloud l4-360 is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9454 processors operating at 2.75 GHz across 90 physical cores and 90 vCPUs with single-threaded core execution. The system features 360 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4 GB per core density, and includes 400 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage. Graphics and acceleration capabilities are provided by four NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L4 GPUs delivering a combined 96 GB of VRAM. Networking architecture provides a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor environment.

Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier execution across high-density computational tasks. The host achieves a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 146191.56, supported by an 86476.64 overall PassMark CPU score and 99948.31 in cryptographic operations. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 707.28 GB/sec, placing it within the top 10 percent of evaluated systems. Hardware vector extensions including AVX-512 VNNI and BF16 complement the CPU architecture for advanced compute operations, while single-thread Geekbench scores reach 2070.0.

The quad NVIDIA L4 configuration establishes strong multi-model LLM throughput, processing small 135M model prompts at 12231.11 tokens/sec and text generation at 433.55 tokens/sec. On medium 7B models, prompt ingestion reaches 2772.24 tokens/sec alongside 54.3 tokens/sec generation. Scaling to large 70B models yields 272.33 tokens/sec prompt ingestion and 5.8 tokens/sec text generation. Storage allocation is relatively constrained at 400 GB NVMe given the 90-core footprint, though Redis SET operations achieve 102.84 million operations/sec, demonstrating strong internal transactional capacity.

This hardware footprint provides balanced resource efficiency for distributed AI inference, multi-stream video pipelines, and high-core parallel software compilation. It is appropriate for production machine learning serving, real-time computer vision, cryptographic processing, and demanding data analytics pipelines requiring combined GPU and high vCPU density.
description: OVHcloud l4-360 is a high-performance GPU-accelerated server featuring 90 dedicated x86_64 cores from an AMD EPYC 9454 processor clocked at 2.75 GHz, paired with 360 GB of RAM. The instance incorporates four NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L4 GPUs providing 96 GB of total VRAM, accompanied by 400 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage and a 25 Gbps network interface. Benchmark metrics highlight exceptional compute capacity, registering top-tier results in stress-ng multi-core execution (146191.56), multi-threaded decompression (707.28 GB/sec), and robust LLM inference speeds spanning 135M to 70B parameter models. Although local disk capacity is moderate relative to the core volume, the platform provides strong resource density and vector instruction support. It is well-fitted for machine learning inference, computer vision, video transcoding, and compute-intensive compilation workloads.
